amount_source: Third ABI argument, stored as one native-USDC Transfer so value_sum equals value_max. The control transaction's argument was 16 minor units, the same as its single Transfer. Three transferWithAuthorization calls in block 50784977 were 2000 minor units, each equal to their single Transfer. Extra receipt hops are not added.
